justification: The only real correspondence is that both depict the human form — A a single frontal standing pillar-like figure with arms bent to the front and hands meeting at the belly, B a narrative chariot scene with a charioteer, an attendant, horses, a wheeled vehicle and a fallen body. The forms, relationships and compositional logic are entirely different: an isolated static frontal figure versus a multi-figure profile action scene with animals and equipment, and the modelling conventions (blocky abstracted volumes versus detailed low-relief profile drawing) do not match.
